performance.scope: Closed VERIFIED trades only; no forecast of future returns
limitations: Drawdown excludes unrealized exposure, deposits and withdrawals.
Null profit factor means no observed losses, not proven profitability.
VERIFIED reflects the ledger label; this tool does not recheck exchange evidence.

shadow-books.db.scope: Latest 10000 recorded snapshots, not complete history

replay_limitations: Historical samples omit contract filters, funding deadlines and order latency.
Snapshots cannot prove fills, hedge execution or realized profit.
Sparse or stale samples cannot establish stop/TP execution between observations.

scanner_funnel.scope: Distinct server_cache snapshots observed over 15 seconds; public market data only
